description_en: Queries the information about a pipeline job
description_zh: 获取工作流任务详情信息
name: GetPipelineRun

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the ID of the pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: pipeline_run_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return detailed information. Valid values:

false: does not return detailed information.
true: returns detailed information that contains Manifest
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回详细信息，取值如下。
关闭开关：不显示详细信息。
打开开关：显示详细信息，目前详细信息包含Manifest字段
parameters.name: verbose

parameters.help_en:
The type of the manifest to be returned. Valid values:

Raw (default): the original manifest submitted by the user.
Frozen: generates a UUID for each pipeline and freeze the pipeline version. Even if you upgrade the pipeline when the three tuples defined on a node remain unchanged, the original UUID is still used. In this case, you can re-run the pipeline based on this manifest.
Rendered: injects related information to the pipeline and renders it, including completing runtime environment information and optimizing pipeline configurations.
Expanded: provides a complete definition for each pipeline.
Runtime: the pipeline to be run
parameters.help_zh:
具体返回哪种类型的Manifest信息，取值如下。
Raw（默认）：用户提交的原始Manifest。
Frozen：针对每个Pipeline生成唯一Uuid，将其版本固化下来。即使遇到子Pipeline定义三元组不变进行升级，依然会使用一开始的版本(Uuid)，不受影响；即可基于该Manifest进行重跑。
Rendered：将相关信息进行注入和渲染，包括：补全运行环境信息并优化等。
Expanded: 针对每个Pipeline补充完整定义。
Runtime：待运行的工作流
parameters.name: manifest_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 被分享的工作流任务的ID
parameters.name: token_id

Accessibility.description_en:
The accessibility of the pipeline job. Valid values:

PUBLIC
PRIVATE
Accessibility.description_zh:
工作流任务的可见性，目前支持：
PUBLIC
PRIVATE

Arguments.description_en: The parameters for the pipeline job

Duration.description_en: The running duration of the pipeline job. Unit: seconds
Duration.description_zh: 工作流任务的运行时长，单位为秒

FinishedAt.description_en: The time when the pipeline job ended, in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard
FinishedAt.description_zh: 工作流任务的结束UTC时间，格式ISO8601

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The time when the pipeline job was created, in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard

GmtModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the pipeline job was modified, in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard

Manifest.description_en: The definition of the pipeline job

Message.description_en: The failure message of the pipeline job
Message.description_zh: 工作流任务失败提示信息

Name.description_en: The name of the pipeline job

Options.description_en: The option for the pipeline job, which is in the JSON format
Options.description_zh: 工作流任务选项，格式为JSON

ParentUserId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to create the pipeline
ParentUserId.description_zh: 创建用户阿里云账号的ID

PipelineRunId.description_en: The ID of the pipeline job

PipelineRunUri.description_en: The URL of the pipeline job

SourceId.description_en: The ID of the pipeline job source

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the pipeline job source. Valid values:

UNKNOWN: If you leave this parameter empty, UNKNOWN is used as the default value.
SDK: The pipeline job is created by using an SDK.
DESIGNER: The pipeline job is created in Machine Learning Designer.
M6: The pipeline job is created on other websites
SourceType.description_zh:
工作流任务来源类型，可能值：
UNKNOWN（默认）：未指定来源类型时的默认值。
SDK：通过SDK创建的工作流任务。
DESIGNER：通过Designer创建的工作流任务。
M6：通过其他网站创建的工作流任务

StartedAt.description_en: The time when the pipeline job started, in UTC. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard
StartedAt.description_zh: 工作流任务的开始UTC时间，格式ISO8601

Status.description_en:
The status of the pipeline job. Valid values:

Initialized
Running
Succeeded
Failed
Suspended
Terminated
Unknown
Skipped
Terminating
Status.description_zh:

Initialized
Running

Failed

Terminated
Unknown

UserId.description_en: The ID of the RAM user that is used to create the pipeline

WorkspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the pipeline job belongs
